items.name: Skills Test 1
items.note: "Skills test 1 will be offered online and is due in week 2." Each of the 6 tests is 10%.

items.name: Skills Test 2
items.note: "Skills Tests 2-5 are short (30 min) quizzes, to be held during the tutorial classes." No week given.

items.name: Skills Test 6
items.note: "Skills Test 6 is an online take-home assignment and assesses the final two weeks of the subject." That says what it covers, not when it is due.

items.name: Final Examination
items.note: "The duration of the final examination is 90 minutes held in the final tutorial (week 12)".
